facts.claim: MetroParks of Butler County lends GRIT all-terrain wheelchairs (one adult-size, one child-size), picked up and returned at the park's Welcome Center. Reservations need a refundable $75 deposit, and the chairs can be used in other parks too.
quote: One adult-sized chair and one child-sized chair are available for public use.
The pick-up and drop-off location for both chairs is the Voice of America MetroPark Welcome Center.
Users are welcome to take the GRIT chairs to any park; they do not need to stay at Voice of America MetroPark or in the MetroParks system.
A refundable $75 deposit is required at the time of reservation.

facts.claim: The park has nine miles of combined paved and natural trails, and it received a Wheel the World Destination designation in 2025.
quote: nine miles of combined paved and natural trails
Voice of America MetroPark received a Wheel the World Destination designation in 2025!

facts.claim: Listed amenities include flush toilets, portable toilets, picnic tables, a playground and water.
facts.quote: Flush Toilets Grills Meeting Room Outdoor Shelter (Reservable) Picnic Tables Playground Port-o-lets/Latrines Water

facts.claim: MetroParks has an accessibility coordinator, reachable at (513) 867-5835 or swingate@yourmetroparks.net.
quote: please contact our Accessibility Coordinator
He can be reached by e-mail at
swingate@yourmetroparks.net
by phone at (513) 867-5835

facts.claim: GRIT reservations are first-come, first-served online or by calling 513-867-5835 Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. The equipment sheet requires collection at the VOA Welcome Center, 7850 VOA Park Drive, during those weekday hours; weekend reservations must be collected Friday.
quote: GRIT Chair reservations are available on a first-come, first-served basis
Reservations can be made online at YourMetroParks.net or by contacting the MetroParks Administrative Office Monday-Friday from 8:30 AM–4:30 PM at (513) 867-5835
Equipment must be picked up at the Voice of America MetroPark Welcome Center (7850 VOA Park Drive, West Chester Township) Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-4:30 PM
Weekend reservations must be picked up on Friday

facts.claim: The equipment sheet says GRIT reservations are free with a $75 deposit per chair at booking, refunded within 5–7 business days after the reservation. Confirm return timing and deposit arrangements with Visitor Services (513-867-5835 or info@yourmetroparks.net).
quote: While GRIT Chair reservations are free, a $75 deposit per chair is required at the time of booking
Deposits will be refunded within 5-7 business days following the reservation
Contact MetroParks’ Visitor Services team at (513) 867-5835 or by email at info@yourmetroparks.net.

facts.claim: The operator’s GRIT Spartan sheet lists a 20-inch seat, 300-pound weight limit and user height range of 4 feet 10 inches to 6 feet 8 inches. It describes a non-motorized chair propelled by hand levers or pushed from behind, with an adjustable/removable footrest. These are published equipment specifications, not individual fit advice.
quote: About Our GRIT Spartan Chair:
This non-motorized chair is designed to be used on pavement, grass, dirt, and primitive hiking trails
Seat width: 20”
Weight limit: 300 lbs.
Height limit: 4’10”- 6’8”
The chair can be self-propelled with hand levers or controlled by someone pushing the chair from behind
The footrest can be adjusted or removed entirely

facts.claim: The GRIT Junior sheet lists a 12-inch seat and 200-pound weight limit. It likewise describes hand-lever propulsion or pushing from behind, and an adjustable/removable footrest; it does not establish personal fit or staff-provided pushing assistance.
quote: About Our GRIT Junior Chair:
Seat width: 12”
Weight limit: 200 lbs.
The chair can be self-propelled with hand levers or controlled by someone pushing the chair from behind
The footrest can be adjusted or removed entirely

facts.claim: For both GRIT models, the sheet says a lap belt is provided but users need enough head/trunk control and endurance to sit upright. It says the chairs lack anterior/lateral trunk supports, armrests and a headrest; users must bring a helmet and keep hands clear of the gears. Discuss the published requirements with the operator before reserving.
quote: A lap belt is provided, but users must have adequate head and trunk control/endurance to sit upright in the chair
The chair does not come with anterior or lateral trunk supports, armrests, or a headrest
Users must have enough safety awareness and body control to keep fingers and hands out of the chair’s gear system
Users must provide their own helmet

facts.claim: The park lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–dusk. The Welcome Center’s general hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m., closed weekends. Equipment collection has separate published arrangements.
quote: Open Daily 8:00 a.m. until Dusk
Voice of America MetroPark Welcome Center Monday-Friday 8:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Saturdays - Sundays Closed

facts.claim: MetroParks welcomes service animals trained to perform specific tasks for a person with disabilities at its facilities and outdoor spaces. It encourages visitors to bring needed personal assistance devices or support people; this does not promise a staff attendant or transfer assistance.
quote: Service animals trained to perform a specific task or tasks for a person with disabilities are welcome at all MetroParks facilities and outdoor spaces.
We encourage individuals to bring any necessary personal assistance devices or support persons to ensure their enjoyment of our parks, programs, and facilities.

facts.claim: The lake page says Rent.Fun kayak and paddleboard rentals are closed for the season and directs visitors to check again in spring 2027 for reopening information. The rental instructions remaining below that notice are not evidence that rentals are currently operating.
facts.quote: Rent.Fun! kayaks and paddleboard rentals are closed for the season. Please check back in Spring 2027 for more information on reopening dates.

facts.claim: MetroParks describes its free adaptive kayak launch, opened in 2021, as using ramps, handrails and platforms for launching canoes, kayaks and other hand-powered craft. Launching hand-carried watercraft is free. The page does not establish transfer help, measured equipment clearances or current launch conditions.
quote: There is no charge to launch hand-carried watercraft at the VOA Lake.
MetroParks opened an adaptive kayak launch in 2021 whic is FREE to use.
The adaptive kayak launch utilizes a series of ramps, handrails and platforms to assist those with varying mobility needs to launch canoes, kayaks and other hand-powered watercraft into VOA Lake.

facts.claim: For a future rental after seasonal reopening, the published process uses the Rent.Fun app and an account, scanning a locker QR code, inspecting the equipment, and returning/locking it in the same unit before ending the rental in the app. The rules require age 18 or older, one person per craft and a life jacket throughout; no companion seat is established.
quote: Download the Rent.Fun app and create an account
Unlock your boat by scanning the QR code on the boat's locker
Remove your equipment- inspect your boat, paddle and life jacket for any damage
Wear your US Coast Guard-approved life jacket at all times
Return and lock your equipment to the same locker unit and select "End Rental" in the app
You must be 18 years or older to use Rent.Fun equipment
One person/watercraft maximum

facts.claim: A trail-rerouting notice still displayed on the News & Alerts page is dated November 12, 2024. It says portions of the VOA cross-country trails will close, marked by signs and barricades. It does not identify affected segments or an end date; confirm current routes rather than treating this old notice as live closure confirmation.
facts.quote: Voice of America MetroPark Cross Country Trail Closures Nov 12, 2024, 11:08 AM Portions of the Voice of America MetroPark Cross Country Trails will be closed for trail rerouting work. Trail closures will be marked with signs and barricades.

facts.claim: Chill Hill sledding is described as available 8 a.m.–dusk in winter when weather and snow permit; visitors bring their own sled and snow gear. The page also mentions a lake/grassland observation deck but does not establish a step-free route to it.
quote: This fantastic venue is available for sledding from 8 a.m. to Dusk daily (weather & snow permitting). Bring your snow gear, sled and have a blast!
In one of the areas near the lake, there is also an observation deck overlooking the grasslands and lake.
